character.prompt: A stocky, broad green-skinned goblin shieldbearer in a dented iron helmet, long pointed ears, scowling. Holds a big round shield in front of its body made from a scavenged brass machine panel: riveted brass plate with a small slotted vent grille and a little brass gear wheel on its face, a strip of deep blue academy cloth with a gold star hanging from its rim. A short iron-tipped spear in its other hand. Patched brown leathers, leather boots. Warm earthy colours: olive green skin, brass, iron, brown leather, deep blue cloth. Detailed pixel art, dark outline.
